verified: Names, descriptions and grades checked against the Exophase trophy list; walkthrough facts, roadmap figures and the missable assessment checked against the PowerPyx trophy guide. Guide text is original, written for this app.

sources.name: Exophase
sources.covers: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.covers: Walkthrough facts, roadmap figures and the missable assessment

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours - there is no extra task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stragglers. Expect around 200 hours all in.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, starts the game - finish it and this pops. Pure story, nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1's main missions through to the end of the chapter. Tip for the whole run: keep a manual save at the end of every chapter - with no mission replay, those saves are your safety net.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; the chapter closes after the mission What's in the Bag? Follow the main-mission markers and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3, which ends after Welcome to Vice City. Another automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 - its last main mission is Starting From Zero. Keep pushing the story and it pops.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for beating the game: complete the final story mission. Once the credits roll, free-roam stays open, so every other trophy can still be earned afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Automatic story progress - no extra step needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Automatic as you play the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only shows after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made during the story already counts. It is about 60% of true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 optional missions, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations. Set aside roughly 100 hours - this is the longest grind and the hardest trophy in the game.
trophies.goal: 100% completion - 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 optional missions

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do 250 stunts out of 397: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Use the map filter Exploration > Stunt Spots and track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts. You need 300 for 100%, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. The map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks them. Most come naturally while chasing the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 range locations. Learn each challenge's target pattern and shoot fast and clean - every challenge can be retried as often as you like.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations (42 races, 3 per location - one win per location is enough). Drone races appear on the map once the area is unfogged; learn each course's racing line.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's 40 race locations - repeat wins at the same spot don't stack. Race markers appear as you explore the map.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at fishing. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui you meet Cal; he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and out-fish him with the normal fishing mechanics.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Four exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (from Chapter 1, use the controllers), and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of one game once is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline - Lucia only, from Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton): he calls, then shows as the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons - dive for treasure at 7 shipwrecks with the metal detector and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3; calling Brian as Jason speeds it up. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline - 5 jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes. All remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Note: the character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do NOT count. Strands that do count include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. He wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) - scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, then drive them back in good condition for better pay. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline - Jason only, from Chapter 3 after Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City: destroy the labs (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut them down for good. Available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The only possibly missable trophy in the game: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot in Leonida - 18 spots at 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 only. After the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the morning - talk to her in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is not confirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required (it adds +1 but isn't listed as a formal spot), so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break).
trophies.when: Chapter 1 - do the house meditation before Chapter 1 ends

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only, starting after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He lends you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (also retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots with purple icons. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck - all 15 are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida; finish any 3 complete sets. Use the map and your collection tracker to find the cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up + R1 to scan things in the world - landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and more; there are far more than 100 scannable spots, so scan as you explore and this pops on its own. Scanning also feeds vehicle discovery and 100% progress.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total; 70 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way to the gold. View them under Progress > Challenges and save the quick easy ones for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. First possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together (call your partner with Right + Triangle). Cause chaos to 4 stars, then escape in a fast sports motorcycle and leave the red heat zone. Easy route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County - cops struggle to follow and the helicopter can't see you. It also pops during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... and while robbing the 8 bank vaults.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Keep the flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time and loot 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline; call your partner with Right + Triangle. A good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop - if it doesn't come, hit a 4th shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 - scanning is enough, you don't need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch; 200 base-model scans are needed for 100%, so this comes automatically. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming - time slows and weak spots are highlighted while the purple focus bar drains. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch it. Line up 5 enemies - gang-operation criminals work best - and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. It doesn't seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus), raised via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal, connected to a boarding bridge - the planes parked on the airfield don't count. Easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4 - drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs - it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick for alarmed doors) and marks jewelry-store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (don't kick the door - that triggers the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (it appears from story progress): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and rob it - bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) - you need his earlier quests done first (2 Payday Loans robberies). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and all 8 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Up to $205,000 per bank - the best money in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... - robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida - fully unfog the whole map. Fastest by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible. Do this early and often, since unfogging also reveals race, activity and collectible markers.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; one per gang is enough for this trophy, but all 39 are required for 100%. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them (many are marked automatically through the story). Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'). Only the blue Banshee counts - a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (marked automatically), rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn - one of the gang operations. Grab all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later - you don't need all 3 in one visit, so it's not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Work out at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities for gyms) - always bring your partner (Right + Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) - a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Profiles range from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) to Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (excessive violence). Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this comes passively while chasing everything else. If you're short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops - but expect them to shoot on sight at Psycho/Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. During the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store - come back later as Lucia alone (no Jason) and rob the same store again, then escape on foot. First possible after Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City: aim at the teller, deal with security, break through the door and empty the 3 cash drawers, then run - the trophy only counts if you escape on foot, not in a vehicle, and the pop is delayed until you're clear of the search area.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside - if it's not there, drive away and come back (the spawn is slightly random). Follow the path into the woods from the car and you'll see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: it drops an abducted woman - talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time, at night after 2 AM

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence - Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while doing the 100% robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money - Ammu-Nation, mod shops and tattoo studios are the most expensive. Any shop spending counts toward the cumulative total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties - the 8 purchasable garages (4 story garages don't count), $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies - especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4 - are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) - each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
